method: Digest-bound original ELF disassembly and static dataflow inspection; no native execution or emulation.

facts.label: store next counter and preserved tail

limitations: Selected caller direct-refill path and in-function SIMD128 fallback only.
No captured code executed/emulated; static instruction checks are not a runtime equivalence test.
CPU feature provider, four alternative implementations, entropy/reseeding, TLS initialization, scheduler and cryptographic security are outside scope.
Valid aligned key state and disjoint writable256-byte output are premises.
